liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Lazy Lightning** (1 review): The long, jammed-out transition from Lazy Lightning to Supplication makes the first set stand out [17]
- **Help On the Way** (1 review): The second set is described as brutal, with fast and loud performances of this song [19]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): The song takes off halfway through, jamming hypnotically with blistering guitar leads from Jerry [25]
- **Playing in the Band** (1 review): A new-age jam breaks out near the end, featuring seagull noises created by Weir [24]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): A weird Space transitions into a beautiful Bob and Jerry duet leading into this song [16]
- **Dupree's** (1 review): A wonky version of this song is cited as being below standard in the first set [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-09-06.beyerm201.holbrook.35084.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 23 songs; 166 min; rated 3.5/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd1983-09-06.mtx.seamons.95820.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 173 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [3]
- **gd1983-09-06.147910.mtx.photoleon.t-flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 172 min [4]
- **gd1983-09-06.170742.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 173 min [6]
- **gd83-09-06.sbd.clugston.5489.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 159 min; rated 4.17/5 by 41 [11]. Said about its sound: The sound quality is rated five stars, though the reviewer notes some patches exist; Sound levels and equalization are wacky until Hell In A Bucket, with some drop-offs to AUD [20][26]

## Around the show

- Three police helicopters swirled overhead with searchlights while the band played at the venue [21]
- Peggy-O and Minglewood Blues get the crowd rocking at the Red Rocks venue [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-09-06.beyerm201.holbrook.35084.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Executive Crew (T.P. K.H.); transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: Beyer M201's (X-Y) > Sony TCD5M (Maxell MX 90, no dolby) 140 feet from stage (behind board) [1]
- **gd1983-09-06.mtx.seamons.95820.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [3]. Also: Mastered from Beyer M201s in X-Y on Sony TCD5M, transferred via Sony TC-RX 370 [3]
- **gd1983-09-06.147910.mtx.photoleon.t-flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Joe Noel; source: A photoLeon Matrix [4]. Also: Nine minutes missing from the SBD Space were patched with a two-source audience mix [4]
- **gd1983-09-06.170742.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Wiseman, Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; AKG SE-5E mics with CE-1 cardioid capsules > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII 90) [6]. Also: Sennheiser 421 source supplies crowd noise and the first few notes of this song [6]
- **gd83-09-06.sbd.clugston.5489.sbeok.shnf**: source: Master Soundboard Cassette > Cassette > DAT > CDR, with AUD patches from 2 Master Audience Cassettes: Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony D5, Sennheiser 441 mics > Sony… [11]

## Art and photos

- Poster by arizjones.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead, 9-06-1983](https://arizjones.blogspot.com/2011/01/grateful-dead-9-06-1983.html) [29]
